subject: Rule 5 draft
title: What is the Rule 5 draft? MLB protection deadline is Nov. 17
answer: The Rule 5 draft lets MLB teams take minor league players that other clubs have left off their 40-man rosters. A pick costs $100,000, and the new team must keep the player on its major league active roster all season or offer him back for $50,000. Clubs must decide whom to protect by 6 p.m. Eastern on Nov. 17, 2026.
body:
Eligibility depends on age and time in the system. A player who signed at 18 or younger becomes eligible before his fifth Rule 5 draft; one who signed at 19 or older, before his fourth. The rule exists so teams cannot hoard young players in the minors while other clubs would use them in the majors. Its name simply comes from its place, rule 5, in baseball's rulebook; the draft has been held every year since 1920.

Some bargains became stars. The Pirates took Roberto Clemente from the Brooklyn Dodgers with the first pick in 1954, and Johan Santana, drafted in 1999, went on to win two Cy Young Awards with Minnesota. Josh Hamilton, Shane Victorino and Dan Uggla were also Rule 5 picks.

The 2026 draft is scheduled for Dec. 9 at the Winter Meetings in San Diego, but it is in doubt. The labor deal expires Dec. 1, and in the 2021 lockout the major league phase was postponed while the minor league phase, which costs $24,000 per pick for Triple-A players, went ahead. The players' union has proposed moving this year's draft into November.
in_the_news: MLB teams must set their 40-man rosters for Rule 5 protection by Nov. 17, 2026, ahead of a draft that a possible lockout could delay.

faq.a: It is scheduled for Dec. 9, 2026, but a lockout after the labor deal expires on Dec. 1 could postpone the major league phase.

faq.q: How much does a Rule 5 pick cost?
faq.a: $100,000 in the major league phase. If the player does not stay on the active roster all season, he must be offered back for $50,000.

faq.q: Who is eligible for the Rule 5 draft?
faq.a: Minor leaguers not on a 40-man roster who signed at 18 or younger and are entering their fifth Rule 5 draft, or signed at 19 or older and are entering their fourth.

faq.q: What is the Rule 5 protection deadline?
faq.a: The day teams must add eligible prospects to the 40-man roster to shield them: 6 p.m. Eastern on Nov. 17, 2026.
